items.quote:
the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, “Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?”
4  He told them what Micah had done for him
items.contrast: The young Levite as the person telling the men versus Micah as the person whose actions are being reported.
items.reason: Micah could be mistaken for the speaker because his actions are the subject of the report. However, the men address the young Levite, and the following “He told them” continues with that same person. The wording clearly asks for the teller, so the key is uniquely supported.
